## Structural overview

Containers and their child fields (from the generated DSL surface):

- **`arg`**: `abbr`, `allowCustomValue`, `contextKey`, `defaultsTo`, `from`, `help`, `inputKind`, `name`, `options`, `required`
- **`create`**: `if`, `ifExists`, `ifNot`, `path`, `template`, `templateFile`
- **`delete`**: `if`, `ifMissing`, `ifNot`, `path`
- **`edit`**: `if`, `ifNot`, `language`, `let`, `ops`, `path`, `when`, `whenNot`
- **`explorerMenuEntry`**: `args`, `if`, `kind`
- **`ifStep`**: `if`, `ifNot`, `steps`
- **`insert`**: `anchor`, `capture`, `query`, `text`
- **`letBinding`**: `as`, `capture`, `extract`, `join`, `name`, `onManyMatches`, `onNoMatch`, `query`
- **`mapRoot`**: `description`, `id`, `map`
- **`opsItem`**: `insert`, `remove`, `replace`
- **`recipeRef`**: `id`, `if`, `ifNot`, `with` _scalar form allowed_
- **`recipeRoot`**: `args`, `description`, `explorerMenu`, `id`, `maps`, `name`, `postExecution`, `queries`, `steps`
- **`remove`**: `capture`, `includeLeadingTrivia`, `query`
- **`replace`**: `capture`, `includeLeadingTrivia`, `query`, `text`
- **`stepsItem`**: `create`, `delete`, `edit`, `if`, `recipe`
- **`variablesRoot`**: `description`, `id`, `values`
- **`with`** _map values_

## Recipe top-level fields

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `id` | Unique recipe identifier. |
| `name` | Human-readable recipe name. |
| `description` | Short recipe description. |
| `args` | Recipe argument definitions shown in the runner UI. |
| `maps` | Recipe-local map entries merged with workspace maps. |
| `queries` | Recipe-local named query definitions. |
| `steps` | Ordered list of edit, create, delete, recipe, or if group steps. |
| `postExecution` | Post-apply shell commands or script paths under the codemod root (Jinja-rendered). |
| `explorerMenu` | Opt-in for the VS Code Explorer Codemod Recipe submenu: list of { kind: file\|folder, if?, args? } (single object is sugar). args maps recipe arg names to MiniJinja expressions over path; first matching entry wins. |

## Map and variables asset fields

### `map`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `id` | Unique map asset identifier. |
| `description` | Short map asset description. |
| `map` | Map lookup table for a workspace map YAML asset (requires id). |

### `variables`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `id` | Unique variables asset identifier. |
| `description` | Short variables asset description. |
| `values` | Constant values for a workspace variables YAML asset (requires id). |

## Step kinds

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `edit` | Patch an existing file with tree-sitter insert, replace, or remove ops. |
| `create` | Create a new file from inline template or templateFile. |
| `delete` | Delete a file from the workspace. |
| `recipe` | Inline another recipe by id, optionally with call-site with bindings. |
| `if` | Run nested steps when shared if / ifNot MiniJinja expressions pass. |

## Edit op kinds

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `insert` | Insert text at a capture anchor (start or end). |
| `replace` | Replace the span of a query capture with new text. |
| `remove` | Remove the span matched by a query capture. |

## Fields

### `arg`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `required` | Whether the recipe arg must be provided. |
| `inputKind` | Runner input widget kind for a recipe arg. |
| `abbr` | Short CLI abbreviation for a recipe arg. |
| `help` | Help text shown in the recipe runner. |
| `defaultsTo` | Default value when the arg is omitted. |
| `options` | Allowed values for choice-style args. |
| `allowCustomValue` | Allow values outside options for choice args. |
| `contextKey` | Deprecated alias of string `from` — editor context key used to prefill this arg. |
| `from` | How to derive this arg from editor context: builtin key, template, or tree-sitter query (like let). |
| `name` | Recipe argument name. |

### `createStep`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `path` | Workspace-relative file path (often templated). |
| `template` | Inline file content for a create step. |
| `templateFile` | Template path resolved recipe-local first, then under .codemod. |
| `ifExists` | Behavior when create target path already exists. |

### `deleteStep`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `path` | Workspace-relative file path (often templated). |
| `ifMissing` | Behavior when delete target path is missing. |

### `editStep`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `if` | MiniJinja expression over recipe args; skip the step when false. |
| `ifNot` | MiniJinja expression over recipe args; skip the step when true. |
| `path` | Workspace-relative file path (often templated). |
| `language` | Tree-sitter language id when extension inference is ambiguous. |
| `when` | Guard queries; all must match before the edit runs. |
| `whenNot` | Forbidden guard queries; edit runs only if none match. |
| `let` | Step-local bindings recomputed before each op. |
| `ops` | Ordered edit operations applied sequentially on the same file. |

### `explorerMenu`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `kind` | Explorer click kind this menu entry applies to. |
| `args` | Map of recipe arg name to MiniJinja expression over the Explorer click path (RHS sees only path + filters). |

### `if`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `steps` | Nested steps gated by the enclosing if step. |

### `insertOp`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `query` | Inline tree-sitter query, .scm path, query-library ref, or chain. |
| `capture` | Capture name from the query whose span is edited. |
| `anchor` | Insertion anchor relative to the capture (start or end). |
| `text` | Replacement or inserted source text (Jinja-rendered). |

### `letBinding`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `extract` | How to derive a let binding value from query captures. |
| `onNoMatch` | Behavior when a let binding query matches nothing. |
| `onManyMatches` | Behavior when a let binding query matches multiple nodes. |
| `join` | Separator when onManyMatches is join. |
| `as` | Jinja template to compute a let value from prior locals. |
| `name` | Let binding local name. |
| `query` | Inline tree-sitter query, .scm path, query-library ref, or chain. |
| `capture` | Capture name from the query whose span is edited. |

### `recipeRef`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `with` | Call-site arg bindings when referencing a child recipe. |
| `id` | Unique recipe identifier for an inlined recipe reference. |

### `recipeRoot`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `query` | Inline tree-sitter query, .scm path, query-library ref, or chain. |

### `removeOp`

| Wire | Description |

| `capture` | Capture name from the query whose span is edited. |
| `includeLeadingTrivia` | Include leading trivia when replacing or removing a capture. |

### `replaceOp`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `query` | Inline tree-sitter query, .scm path, query-library ref, or chain. |
| `capture` | Capture name from the query whose span is edited. |
| `text` | Replacement or inserted source text (Jinja-rendered). |
| `includeLeadingTrivia` | Include leading trivia when replacing or removing a capture. |

## Enum values

### `anchor`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `start` | Insert before the capture span. |
| `end` | Insert after the capture span. |

### `extract`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `text` | Capture source text. |
| `kind` | Tree-sitter node kind name. |
| `exists` | True when the capture matched. |
| `count` | Number of capture matches. |

### `ifExists`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `fail` | Abort the recipe when the create path already exists. |
| `skip` | Skip the create step when the path already exists on disk or was staged earlier in this recipe run. |

### `ifMissing`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `fail` | Abort when deleting a missing file. |
| `skip` | Skip delete when the file is already absent. |

### `inputKind`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `text` | Free-text arg input. |
| `file` | File path arg input. |
| `directory` | Directory path arg input. |
| `choice` | Pick from options list. |

### `kind`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `file` | Show when the Explorer selection is a file. |
| `folder` | Show when the Explorer selection is a folder. |

### `onManyMatches`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `error` | Fail when multiple matches. |
| `first` | Use the first matching capture. |
| `join` | Join all matches with join separator. |

### `onNoMatch`

| Wire | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `error` | Fail the edit when no match. |
| `use` | Use an empty value when no match. |
